# SpeakStone Forever - Main

SpeakStone's base add-on for **WoW Forever** (Classic+, interface `16001`). Quests, greetings and books are read
aloud with voices similar to the in-game characters, not a generic narrator.

Unofficial; not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment.

Website: https://speakstone.beanw.co.uk

## What it does

SpeakStone reads World of Warcraft out loud. Open a quest, talk to an NPC or read a book, and you hear it in a voice
similar to the in-game character who says it, not one generic narrator. The same NPC keeps the same voice in their
quests, their greetings and their books.

![Welcome tutorial](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Main/main/docs/screenshots/01_welcome_tutorial.png)

- **Quests, greetings and books, voiced.** Quest text (description, progress, completion), NPC greetings and book pages.
- **Choose how it reads.** Full narration, story only, or manual (press Play).
  Show a compact speech bar, subtitles or nothing at all, with a portrait or a moving 3D head of the speaker.
- **Walk away and keep listening.** The speech bar carries on after you leave the NPC. Talk to someone else and their
  line waits its turn instead of cutting the first one off.
- **Read-along.** The words being spoken are highlighted as the voice reads them.
- **Pause and Resume** pick up from where you stopped.
- **Controller and TV support.** Xbox and PlayStation button prompts, big text for playing from the sofa, a rumble when
  a quest is queued, and a tutorial you can finish without a mouse.
- **Dialogue UI support.** Its play button plays SpeakStone, its text follows the voice, and quests queue or wait in combat.
- **Dyslexia-friendly fonts** (Atkinson Hyperlegible, Lexend, Andika, OpenDyslexic and more) and Parchment, Stone and
  Midnight themes.
- **The SpeakStone Guide.** Browse and play every voiced quest, greeting and book in game.
- **Help fill the gaps.** Lines with no voice yet are noted as you play, so they can be added.

| | |
|---|---|
| ![Controller and TV](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Main/main/docs/screenshots/02_controller_and_tv.png) | ![Choose how it reads](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Main/main/docs/screenshots/03_choose_how_it_reads.png) |
| Controller and TV support | Choose how it reads |
| ![Dialogue UI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Main/main/docs/screenshots/04_dialogue_ui.png) | ![Walk away, keep listening](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Main/main/docs/screenshots/06_walk_away_keep_listening.png) |
| Dialogue UI support | Walk away, keep listening |
| ![Read-along](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Main/main/docs/screenshots/07_read_along.png) | ![The Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Main/main/docs/screenshots/08_guide.png) |
| Read-along highlighting | The SpeakStone Guide |
| ![Fonts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Main/main/docs/screenshots/09_reading_fonts.png) | ![Help fill the gaps](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Main/main/docs/screenshots/05_help_fill_the_gaps.png) |
| Dyslexia-friendly fonts and themes | Help fill the gaps |

## How it works

1. **This add-on is the player.** It holds the code, the settings, the Guide and the quest and book text, but no audio.
2. **The voice packs hold the audio.** Each pack is its own add-on (Audio Packs 1 to 3, plus Chatter for greetings) and registers its lines with this
   add-on when the game loads. Install the packs for the content you play; a line whose pack is missing is simply silent.
3. **When a quest, greeting or book opens**, SpeakStone looks the line up by quest ID and part (description, progress,
   completion), by NPC and greeting, or by book and page, and plays it if a pack has it. Long lines are stored in parts
   of about 10 to 15 seconds, cut in natural pauses, so Pause and Resume can carry on from where you stopped.
4. **Lines with no voice yet are saved as you play** (quest text, greetings and book pages, and who said them). Export
   them from the minimap button (right-click) and paste them on the [website](https://speakstone.beanw.co.uk/), or let
   the free SpeakStone Worker app send them for you. New lines are usually voiced by the next day and arrive in the
   packs with their next update.

![Minimap button](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Main/main/docs/screenshots/10_minimap_button.png) ![/ss](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Main/main/docs/screenshots/11_slash_ss.png)

### Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/ss` | Settings and the Guide |
| `/ss tutorial` | Run the setup tutorial again |
| `/ssauto on` or `off` | Autoplay on or off |
| `/ssmissing` | Text captured for quests with no voice, ready to paste on the website |
| `/ssharvest export` | Export everything captured (also: right-click the minimap button) |
| `/qrlibrary` | The Guide |

Minimap button: left-click opens Settings, right-click exports captured text, middle-click toggles chat messages.

## The website and the Worker

[speakstone.beanw.co.uk](https://speakstone.beanw.co.uk/): paste the text you captured so it gets a voice, hear samples,
and get the Worker.

The **SpeakStone Worker** (optional, Windows and Linux) keeps your SpeakStone add-ons up to date, sends the text you
capture, and can lend your graphics card to make new lines while the PC is idle. It steps aside whenever another
program needs the card. You can also **lend your voice**: record a couple of minutes on the website and it can be used
for characters in SpeakStone. Free, a person listens to every take, and you can withdraw at any time.

| | |
|---|---|
| ![Website](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Main/main/docs/screenshots/12_website.png) | ![Worker setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Main/main/docs/screenshots/13_worker_setup.png) |
| The SpeakStone website | SpeakStone Worker setup |
| ![Worker board](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Main/main/docs/screenshots/14_worker_board.png) | ![Lend your voice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Main/main/docs/screenshots/15_lend_your_voice.png) |
| The Worker at work | Lend your voice |

## Install

1. **SpeakStone Forever - Main** (this addon: code only, no audio)
2. **SpeakStone Forever Audio Pack 1** ([SpeakStone_Forever_Audio_Pack1](https://github.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Audio_Pack1))
3. **SpeakStone Forever Audio Pack 2** ([SpeakStone_Forever_Audio_Pack2](https://github.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Audio_Pack2))
4. **SpeakStone Forever Audio Pack 3** ([SpeakStone_Forever_Audio_Pack3](https://github.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Audio_Pack3)): books
5. **SpeakStone Narration - Forever Chatter** ([SpeakStone_Forever_Chatter](https://github.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Forever_Chatter)): NPC greetings and some quests

Install all five. Every audio pack requires this add-on. Without Chatter, nearly every NPC greeting is
silent, as are some quests; without Audio Pack 3, books are silent.

## Credits

Quest and dialogue text for WoW Forever is matched from community data by Efficient Games (EG Link), licensed under CC BY 4.0: https://github.com/JIVESCORP/eg-link-output-wowf

Unofficial; not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment.

## Built from SpeakStone_Main

Everything here is produced by `tools/build_forever_main.py` from the retail
[SpeakStone_Main](https://github.com/dandwhelan/SpeakStone_Main) payload.
Exactly three things differ from retail:

1. `## Interface: 16001`
2. `## Title: SpeakStone Forever - Main`
3. SavedVariables renamed to `SpeakStone_ForeverMainDB` (in the `.toc` and every Lua reference)

Captures made on this client are reported to the site as `flavour: "forever"`
by `Harvester.lua`, from the interface number. Quest IDs are only unique within
one game, so this is what keeps Forever quest text from merging into retail's.

Fixes belong in SpeakStone_Main; rebuild this rather than editing it.

Player site: https://speakstone.beanw.co.uk

# Changelog

## 6.1.3 (2026-11-24)

Voices similar to the in-game characters. Unofficial; not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment.

Version 6.1.3 covers the base add-ons (retail and WoW Forever). The voice packs do not change.

### What's new

- **Works with the SpeakStone Worker app.** If you run the Worker (version 1.2.23 or later), it sends the quest, gossip and book text SpeakStone noted for you to the website after you play, so there is nothing to copy and paste. Once the website confirms it has them, SpeakStone clears those lines from its saved text the next time you log in, just as pasting the export does, and does not note the same lines again.
- Nothing changes if you do not use the Worker: `/ssharvest export` and the website's paste box work as before.

## 6.1.2 (2026-11-24)

Voices similar to the in-game characters. Unofficial; not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment.

Version 6.1.2 covers the base add-ons (retail and WoW Forever). Update the voice packs as well: Pause and Resume from where you stopped needs the new packs.

### What's new

- **Pause and Resume now carry on from where you stopped**, instead of starting the line again. Pause on the Read Quest, quest log and greeting buttons, the speech bar, the subtitle bar, the Guide or a controller, and Resume picks the line back up.
- **Good to know:** Resume goes back to the start of the part you paused in, so you may hear up to the last 10 to 15 seconds again. World of Warcraft cannot pause a sound or start one part-way through, so long lines are now stored in parts of about 10 to 15 seconds, each cut in a natural pause between sentences. Lines shorter than that are a single part and start again from the top.
- A quest that is handed in to a different character for Horde and Alliance can now have a voice for each of them. First use: the "A Sealed Crate" quests in WoW Forever, where Dokimi and Marcy Baker each speak in their own voice.

### Please update together

- Update SpeakStone itself along with the voice packs. With new packs and an older SpeakStone (before 6.1.1), long lines are silent.

## 6.1.1 (2026-11-23)

Voices similar to the in-game characters. Unofficial; not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment.

Version 6.1.1 covers the base add-ons (retail and WoW Forever). The voice packs are unchanged.

### What's new

- Pause and resume on the Read Quest, quest log and greeting buttons (resuming starts the line again; shift-click always starts from the top). The quest log also has a Stop button.
- Click the subtitle bar, or use its menu, to pause and resume. The speech bar pauses too.
- A Pause/Resume button in the Guide, beside Stop audio (quests and greetings, not whole books).
- Previous: hear the line before again, from the speech bar, the controller's left trigger or a new key binding.
- When one of Blizzard's own talking heads speaks, your quest line pauses and starts again once it has finished (unless "Silence Blizzard's voice lines" is on).
- The speech bar fades less in combat and no longer hides behind the talking head, and the moving 3D head now shows the right character.
- Help us fill the gaps: for quest lines where we don't yet know which character speaks, the add-on notes the character when you open that quest and includes it in your text export.

### Fixed

- Books opened with Dialogue UI start on page 1 instead of jumping to the last page.
- Blizzard's talking-head text is no longer lit up while SpeakStone is reading over its silenced voice.

## 6.0.3 (November 2026)

### Speech bar
- **Compact speech bar shows four lines** instead of three, and the text now rolls up smoothly with the voice instead of stepping a line at a time.
- **The line being spoken stays in the middle of the bar**, following the highlighted word, and the last sentence rolls up to the middle too instead of stopping at the bottom.
- **Soft top and bottom edges**: text fades out gently at the edges of the bar when there is more above or below.
- **Narration stands apart from speech**: parts in angle brackets (stage directions, read by the narrator) are shown on their own line, indented, a size smaller and in a softer colour, without the brackets.
- On a controller, the TV-size text is a little smaller.

### Other
- The settings window is slimmer, and controller button pictures show on game versions that lack the game's own button art.
- Fixed the subtitle preview ignoring your settings in WoW Forever.
- Fixed a possible error when the quest log looked up the selected quest.

## 6.0.2 (November 2026)

- Controller: the tutorial page, its tooltip and the first-run "which controller?" popup now show your pad's own button pictures too.
- Voice packs: lines that had a pause in the middle of a word are back to their original timing (separate pack updates).

## 6.0.1 (November 2026)

## 6.0.1 (November 2026)

### Controller support for the speech bar
- **Controller button pictures**: every button name (the legend, the gear menu, the tutorial) now shows as your controller's own button picture, Xbox letters or PlayStation shapes, instead of text like [A].
- **Compact speech bar on a controller**: three lines that scroll along with the voice, so a whole passage doesn't sit in the middle of the screen while you walk around. Mouse and keyboard players can turn it on too: gear menu or /ss > "Compact: three scrolling lines".
- **While you hold the bar, its own Pause, Next, Replay and Stop buttons show the controller button that works each one.**
- The scrolling text always stops on whole lines, so no line is cut in half.
- Fixed an error when switching between the controller and the mouse.
- **Asks which controller you use** (Xbox or PlayStation) the first time you press a controller button, or picks it up on its own when the pad names itself. Change it in the bar's gear menu > Controller.
- **Take the bar with View (Xbox) / Create (PlayStation)** while it is on screen. Then: A/Cross pause or resume, X/Square next queued quest, Y/Triangle replay, B/Circle stop, D-pad moves the bar, LB/RB or L1/R1 change its size. Press View/Create again, wait a few seconds, or move a stick and the buttons go back to the game. Never takes buttons in combat.
- **The tutorial works with a controller**: D-pad moves a gold box between buttons and tick boxes, A/Cross picks, B/Circle goes back a page, LB/RB (L1/R1) turn pages. No mouse needed.
- **New Controller page in the tutorial**: pick Xbox, PlayStation or keyboard and mouse; turn on the game's own controller support if it is off; and "Make it easy" options: a bigger speech bar at the top, the button legend, auto-accept and queue quests, and which button takes the speech bar. One button sets all the controller-friendly choices. Players who already did the tutorial only see this page if the game's controller support is on.
- A small legend under the bar names the buttons for your controller.
- **New key bindings**: Stop, Next, Replay and "take the speech bar", so you can put them on any controller combination in the game's bindings.
- **TV size for the speech bar**: text size (Normal / Large / Extra large), 3 or 4 lines at a time, and the text now glides up smoothly as it is read instead of jumping. In the gear menu, and one tick on the tutorial's Controller page (bigger bar, extra-large text, 3 lines, top of the screen).
- **Speech bar in combat**: keep showing, fade back, or hide (the voice carries on). Gear menu > In combat; the controller settings hide it.
- **Bigger tutorial with a controller**: the tutorial window grows (as much as fits the screen) when a controller is in use.
- **Rumble**: a short buzz when a quest joins the queue, two when the next queued quest starts. On by default with a controller; tick on the Controller page.
- **The speech bar steps aside on flight paths and in cutscenes** (the voice carries on). Gear menu > Hide on flight paths.
- **TV size only while you are on the controller**: pick up the mouse and the bar goes back to your own sizes; touch the pad and it grows again. Gear menu > TV size while using a controller.
- **The settings window (/ss) works with a controller**: D-pad between options, A/Cross to pick, dropdowns open into a list you can scroll, sliders move with left/right, B/Circle closes.
- **The speech bar now starts at the top of the screen** instead of above the action bars. Gear menu > Reset position moves an existing bar there.

## 6.0.0 (November 2026)

**6.0.0 is a big one: the voices have been overhauled, and characters now speak with emotion.**
